mapper.select: select a.ip, a.total_requests, a.last_access_time, a.count404, a.auth_failure_count, coalesce(c.peak_per_minute, 0) AS peak_per_minute from (select ip, count(*) as total_requests, max(access_time) as last_access_time, sum(case when status_code = 404 then 1 else 0 end) as count404, sum(case when status_code in (401, 403) then 1 else 0 end) as auth_failure_count from access_log where upload_task_id = #{taskId} group by ip) a left join(select ip, max(cnt) peak_per_minute from (select ip, date_format(access_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as minute_bucket, count(*) as cnt from access_log where upload_task_id = #{taskId} group by ip, minute_bucket) b group by ip) c on a.ip = c.ip;
